nodes.description: Immutable constant address _TRADE_RESERVE that receives all Ether and ERC20 tokens held by this contract.
receive() external payable fallback that accepts incoming Ether transfers.
settleEther() external function that forwards the whole contract balance to _TRADE_RESERVE via a low-level call and bubbles up revert data on failure.
settleERC20(IERC20 token) external function that transfers the full token balance of this contract to _TRADE_RESERVE.
Low-level call `_TRADE_RESERVE.call{value: address(this).balance}("")` in settleEther, forwarding the entire Ether balance to an external address.
External call `token.transfer(_TRADE_RESERVE, token.balanceOf(address(this)))` on a caller-supplied token contract in settleERC20.
Parameter `token` of settleERC20, an arbitrary caller-supplied IERC20 implementation used as the external call target.
Local variable `ok` in settleEther holding the success flag returned by the low-level call.
Local variable `ok` in settleERC20 holding the boolean result of token.transfer, checked by require.

edges.reason: settleEther executes the low-level value call that drains the contract balance to _TRADE_RESERVE.
The state variable _TRADE_RESERVE supplies the callee address of the low-level call.
The success flag returned by the low-level call is assigned to the local variable ok.
settleERC20 performs the external token.transfer call to move the whole token balance.
The caller-supplied parameter token determines the target contract of the external transfer call.
The boolean result of token.transfer is assigned to the local variable ok and enforced by require.
The state variable _TRADE_RESERVE is used as the destination address of the ERC20 transfer.
Incoming Ether accepted by receive() becomes the balance spent by the subsequent settleEther() call.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter token is only used as the receiver of the external token.transfer call and can be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
Local variable ok merely carries the success flag of the low-level call in settleEther and can be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
Local variable ok only stores the result of token.transfer in settleERC20 and can be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
